questions.q: Explain one advantage of a tax over a ban as a way to reduce pollution.

ideas.label: A tax keeps an incentive to cut pollution further, or lets firms choose
It also raises revenue, or avoids black markets, or uses the market

questions.model: A tax gives firms an incentive to keep cutting pollution and lets them choose how. It also raises revenue, which a ban does not.
questions.why: A tax keeps the market working, and pays for itself.

tests.answer: A tax gives firms an incentive to find cleaner methods, and it raises revenue.
